row.notes: myteam-g2: Reads the boolean field claimed from a saved JSON value into obj+0x28 (1 byte); returns 0 on success, 0x58 if the value is not boolean, 0x57 if missing, and records the error code in the thread error stack. Used by Career_Sponsors_Remove and Career_TeamRenownAndForm_Deserialise (renown reward claimed flag). Hook: forcing obj+0x28 marks a reward as claimed.

verify.notes: V9616 Reads boolean "claimed" into obj+0x28; 0x58 wrong type, 0x57 missing, error stored in TLS stack.
